definitions.content: A device intended to perform a particular function, directly involved in elaborating, transmitting or displaying measurement results.

notes.content: An ancillary device may or may not be subject to legal metrology control according to its function in the measuring system or to national regulations.

definitions.content: Dispositif destiné à accomplir une fonction particulière directement impliquée dans l'élaboration, la transmission ou l'affichage de résultats de mesurage.
